display_long_description:
Experience the Alhambra as if you were truly there.

This virtual reality experience allows you to explore the historic Alhambra with an astonishing level of detail and realism. Thanks to cutting-edge graphics, every room, courtyard, and corridor has been faithfully recreated—from the Nasrid architecture to the monument’s unique atmosphere.

The app offers two experience modes to suit all types of users:

🔹 Tour Mode
Explore the Alhambra following a carefully designed route. As you move forward, explanatory audio guides accompany you, narrating the history, art, and purpose of each space. This mode turns the visit into an educational and immersive experience, perfect for learning while being fully absorbed in the journey.

🔹 Free Mode
Explore without limits. Move freely through the environments, stop wherever you like, and discover every corner at your own pace. This mode is designed for those who want to enjoy the surroundings, observe architectural details, or simply lose themselves in the beauty of the place.

Whether used as an educational tool, a cultural visit, or an immersive experience, this app transforms the Alhambra into an interactive journey through time, accessible from anywhere in the world.

A unique way to discover one of history’s most iconic monuments, combining technology, culture, and emotion in an unforgettable VR experience.
